listing.name: Music Switcher
listing.summary: # This mod allows you to mix and match custom music with vanilla music using LunaLib's options (startup menu screen, top left corner)
listing.aiSummary: Lets you decide what music plays, when, and for whom without touching your save file.

description:
Music Switcher

With sample custom music from Honkai: Star Rail

Music Switcher lets you decide what music plays, when, and for whom — without touching your save file.

Most noticeably,

combat is no longer silent!

Expect some epic boss music when you fight REDACTED opponents.

Adds a settings panel (Top-left on the main menu -> Mod Settings -> “Music Switcher”) where you pick the rule set for every faction and situation:

Vanilla behaves as if this mod doesn't exist for the faction.  Custom always play the custom tracks supplied by Music Switcher (or supplied by the user/other mods, following instructions below).  Both randomly flip between Custom and Vanilla each time a track would start.

Can work with other music packs that supply music (unless they also hijack the music player)

Music Switcher only modifies which music ID is requested; it does not replace existing audio files.  Safe to add or remove mid-campaign.

Dependencies:

LunaLib

and

LazyLib

Note that Sindrian Diktat is left vanilla by default because I couldn't find HSR tracks fitting their vibes, but feel free to use some of your own. See below or the readme file or the in-game instructions in Lunasettings on how to add your custom music.

For players

interested in using self-supplied tracks:SpoilerYou can replace sample custom music in this mod with anything you like (file must be in .ogg format), or add it to the shuffle.

To replace:

Simply navigate to the /Starsector/mods/Music Switcher/sounds folder, find whatever .ogg file you want to replace, delete it, rename your own .ogg file to what it used to be and paste in its place. Note that .mp4 and other formats are not recognized by the game.

To add multiple tracks to a shuffle:

1 Do the same as above, but since only one file can use the old file's name, you need to rename the rest into for example MyMusicFile2.ogg

2 Open /Starsector/mods/Music Switcher/data/config/sounds.json with a notepad, Ctrl+F to search for the first file name, for example

"CustomDiktatEncounterHostile.ogg",

and add

"MyMusicFile2.ogg",

one line below it (inside the overarching "files":[   ] bracket)

Don't lose the comma at the end of each line, tweak the volume if you want to.

Restart the game to take effect.

If you fiddled with sounds.json and the game refuses to start and gives you an error message, you probably missed/duplicated a comma or a bracket.

[close]

For modders

interested in supplying combat music for your mod's faction:SpoilerYou can add customized combat music and let Music Switcher play it when the player fights your mod's faction:

1 Add the following to your myfaction.faction file

"music": {"combat": "Custom_music_myfaction_combat"}

2 Add the following to your mod's sounds.json (If you don't haven one, create data/config/sounds.json and then add)

"music":

{

"Custom_music_myfaction_combat":

[

{

"source":"sounds/Combat/",

"volume":0.80,

"file":"MyMusicFile2.ogg",

}

]

}

3 Create a sounds/Combat/ folder, put MyMusicFile2.ogg inside.

4 Instruct the player to use

Music Switcher

if they want to hear custom music while fighting your faction. This would be a soft dependency, meaning that they can plug out

Music Switcher

at any time, and other functions of your mod will be unaffected.

[close]

v1.5:19/06/2025-Overhauled the code for better compatibility. Should also run a bit faster and eat less RAM.

v1.4: 07/04/2025-Added music and options for SUPER and VERY REDACTED stuff introduced in 0.98.

v1.3: 02/04/2025-Updated compatibility for Starsector 0.98.

v1.2a: 17/05/2024-Forgot to update the download link, if you downloaded v1.2 it was probably still v1.1.

v1.2: 17/05/2024-Slightly tweaked sample music - add the new HSR boss theme as the hostile mysterious encounter music.

v1.1: 19/04/2024-Added Github download and version checker support. Fixed some options not working.

v1.0: 15/04/2024-Official release. Fixed crash due to arcade/simulation having no music.

v0.9: 14/04/2024-Added (a lot of) combat music, trimmed existing music, rewrote code.

v0.1b: 27/03/2024-You don't need to download unless you want to change player faction music into a non-vanilla faction using Nexerelin's music option: Fixed compatibility. Also added a readme file & Changed the menu icon.

v0.1a: 21/03/2024-Fixed crash upon arriving at dead-drop target location due to having no music

v0.1: 21/03/2024-New Mod Created

v0.1.1: 11/03/2024-Added Simulated Universe menu tracks for exploration, tweaked volumes
